title: Embedded game window opens taskbar when focused
body:
### Tested versions

I have this issue in v4.4.1 stable

### System information

Zorin OS (Ubuntu) on AMD CPU

### Issue description

I am not sure if this can be prevented by Godot or if this is simply OS related. 
In Zorin OS it is possible to configure the taskbar to automatically hide if an application fills the entire screen. The taskbar pops back into view if a window is focussed that is not crossing the taskbar. 
Since the embedded game window of the new game tab is not actually part of the engine but a window with hidden header, whenever I click that window, since it is smaller and does not reach down and over the taskbar, the taskbar pops into view preventing view on the Output/Debugger/etc-tab-titles. 
This is only a small inconvenience but it is slightly annoying because when a non-crucial error arrives the debugger text is colourised red which I would not notice when the game continues running and I cannot see the lower tab.

Example:
After starting the game with the run button the game tab opens and focussed the game window opening the taskbar:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6e61bb51-2397-4772-95cc-8b606a0b033d)

When I click the engine, the taskbar collapses and I can finally see the lower bar and that there are two debugger warnings.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/73fd423b-50e6-4009-826e-39a89e320166)

If I would click back into the game window, the taskbar would pop up again preventing view in the debugger text so I would not see any severe error showing up. 

### Steps to reproduce

Works with any project. Just use the embed game window in engine feature. 

A system requirement would be to have a similar taskbar behaviour like in Zorin OS.
